title: setup: a user holding view_all_audit_log has no Audit Log entry in Setup (it sits under group_diagnostics, gated by manage_platform_settings), and the Setup landing page answers 403 for them
body:
Found by a downstream app on the published 18.4.0 packages (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm, separation-of-duties roles: system / security / audit officer).

## Symptom

- An auditor whose only Setup-relevant grant is `view_all_audit_log` (the app's `carbon_audit_officer`) opens Setup and finds **no 审计日志 / Audit Log entry** in the sidebar. The list itself works when opened by URL (`/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_audit_log`).
- For all three officer roles, the Setup landing page is 「打包动作 / Packaged Actions」, which shows `activation ledger HTTP 403`.

## Producer (measured downstream)

`nav_audit_logs` is contributed into `group_diagnostics` (`@objectstack/plugin-audit` dist `index.js` ~line 14995), and `group_diagnostics` requires `manage_platform_settings` (`@objectstack/platform-objects`), so a user who may read the audit log but not manage platform settings never sees the entry. The landing page is chosen without regard to whether the user can read it.

## Suggested fix shape (for the lane to judge)

Gate the Audit Log entry on `view_all_audit_log` (its own read permission), not on the group's admin permission; and pick the Setup landing page among entries the user can open.

Dedupe words: audit log nav auditor · group_diagnostics manage_platform_settings audit · setup landing packaged actions 403.
